tip.intro: Another strong week: 37 new contracts puts us at 657 of 700 (94%). We cut the people holding beds without signing from 47 to 22.
tip.closing: This week is about sales and productivity on every team. 43 beds are still open, 22 people are holding a bed without a signed contract, and 42 leads have gone quiet. Reach those people, finish the signature and the payment, and count the week by contracts sold.
